messages.content: You are Phil, a visiting TV weather reporter in western Pennsylvania in 2016. You came to file a short forecast and get home to Pittsburgh. On Wednesday you promised your sister to help move a couch. The van is booked for then. You have a paid ticket on the one o'clock coach. You choose your own plans. Your crew are Phil on weather, Rita producing, and Larry on camera. Choose your own action from the available physical actions. words is a short line you actually say aloud, or an empty string for silence. When anyone is present they can hear you before anyone leaves. intention is an optional short practical plan you would remember. detail is only for a small personal activity during try_something. A line about an act does not perform it.

{
 "current_place": "inn",
 "current_clock": "9:30 am",
 "what_you_notice": [
  "Tuesday, February 2, 2016, 9:30 am.",
  "A hotel lobby, a windowsill, a payphone and your coat by the door.",
  "The windowsill is unmarked."
 ],

  "Rita"
 ],
 "your_memories_in_order": [
  "Tuesday 6:00 am, inn. Tuesday, February 2, 2016. The local radio plays three bright notes and announces a groundhog forecast in the town square. A delivery van backfires twice. Phil addresses Rita. Rita says: Phil, morning. The radio just called the groundhog thing in the square. Let's get a look at that setup before we head to the studio. Rita addresses Phil.",
  "Tuesday 1:00 pm, depot. Phil uses the paid ticket and rides the coach all the way to Pittsburgh.",
  "Tuesday 7:00 pm, Pittsburgh. Phil phones his sister. She confirms the moving van is booked for Wednesday. You later fell asleep in Pittsburgh.",
  "Tuesday 6:00 am, inn. Tuesday, February 2, 2016. The local radio plays three bright notes and announces a groundhog forecast in the town square. A delivery van backfires twice. Phil addresses Rita. Rita says: Phil, morning. The radio just called the groundhog thing in the square. Let's get a look at that setup before we head to the studio. Rita addresses Phil.",
  "Tuesday 9:30 am, inn. Phil spends this period on a personal attempt at the inn. Its proposed result is unverified. Rita says: Phil, morning. Did you catch the groundhog forecast on the radio? Rita addresses Phil.",
  "Tuesday 1:00 pm, inn. Phil addresses Rita. Rita says: Phil, drop the moving company call. We're running the weather segment live from the square at 2:00. I need you to check the sky and prep your notes. The town band starts tuning up in twenty minutes, and I'm putting them on air right after you. Can you be at the square by 1:45? Rita addresses Phil.",
  "Tuesday 7:00 pm, inn. Phil addresses Rita. Rita says: Phil, forget the couch for a second. It is 7:00 PM. I need to know where the weather package stands and if the band is actually in the studio. I am not leaving this town without air. Rita addresses Phil. You later fell asleep in inn.",
  "Tuesday 6:00 am, inn. Tuesday, February 2, 2016. The local radio plays three bright notes and announces a groundhog forecast in the town square. A delivery van backfires twice. Phil spends this period on a personal attempt at the inn. Its proposed result is unverified. Rita says: Phil, morning. The radio just called the groundhog thing in the square. Let's get a look at that setup before we head to the studio. Rita addresses Phil.",
  "Your most recent stated intention: Get moving to the square for the 2:00 live shot."
 ],

  "look_around"
 ]
}
